generalAbilities.name: Site Bound
generalAbilities.description:
A screaming sulfur becomes bound to the location where the people whose souls make up its form died. It can stray up to 1,000 feet from this site of death, or up to 100 feet from the edges of any waterway associated with its death, whichever distance is shorter.

A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

defensiveAbilities.name: Agonizing Cries
defensiveAbilities.description:
30 feet. The screaming sulfur constantly shrieks with the pained wails of countless spirits.

A living creature that enters or starts its turn in the aura must succeed at a DC 26 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 1 as long as it remains in the aura (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rejuvenation
defensiveAbilities.description:
Blessing the site where the screaming sulfur was formed and burying whatever dead remain allows the spirits within the screaming sulfur to move on to the afterlife, rendering it inert.

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after 2d4 days within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Choke
offensiveAbilities.description: The screaming sulfur bombards all creatures within its Agonizing Cries aura with visions of death and a feeling of suffocation. Each creature takes 4d6 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 26 Will Saving Throw save).
